description:
Welcome to the enchanting world of Norian Love's romance novels, where passion, intrigue, and unexpected turns of fate converge to create captivating stories that keep you on the edge of your seat. Norian Love is acclaimed as the "Plot Twist King," renowned for his unparalleled ability to weave intricate narratives that are as unpredictable as they are emotionally resonant. With a dedicated following of avid readers, his novels have sparked a movement, and his brand has expanded to offer a range of exquisite merchandise that allows fans to immerse themselves even further into the worlds he creates. 

What sets Norian Love's romance novels apart is his unmatched ability to surprise and delight readers with jaw-dropping plot twists that leave them reeling and hungry for more. With each turn of the page, readers are taken on an unpredictable roller-coaster ride of emotions, ensuring that they are always kept guessing and engaged. This element of surprise, combined with his authentic portrayal of his diverse characters as multidimensional protagonists, speaks directly to the hearts of his target audience.

Calling All Affiliates: Are you an influencer or content creator seeking a dynamic and culturally resonant brand to promote? Join us in spreading the magic of Norian Love's romance novels and merchandise. Our ideal affiliate partners are those who connect with readers, offering them a literary escape that speaks to their experiences and aspirations. By partnering with Norian Love, you'll not only introduce your audience to captivating stories but also offer them a chance to own a piece of the magic through our exclusive merchandise line.

Become an affiliate of Norian Love and share in the joy of captivating storytelling and beautifully designed merchandise that celebrate the essence of love, growth, and the unexpected.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to the heart of Norian Love, and thank you for embarking on this journey with us as a valued member of our Affiliate Program.

This document outlines the essential terms and conditions that govern your participation as an affiliate, promoting our cherished products and services. These guidelines are designed to ensure a harmonious and productive relationship between us, the merchant, and you, our esteemed affiliate.

1. Registration Approval

We hold the discretion to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration. This decision is final, and we appreciate your understanding should your application not be accepted.

2. Utilizing Affiliate Links and Coupons

Your unique affiliate link is automatically generated for ease of use, and you may also create specific product or collection links. Should a customer engage with multiple referral links, the most recent click-through—yours—will be the one that counts.

You may be provided with a coupon code, detailed within your Dashboard. The use of this code is exclusive; combining it with an affiliate link does not compound commissions. Unauthorized promotion of non-assigned coupons is prohibited.

Feel free to promote our website through various channels, including social media platforms like Facebook and Instagram, as well as traditional media outlets such as classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commission Structure and Payments

Earn commissions by directing customers to our website, based on our structured commission rates. Commissions are calculated from the order value, excluding additional fees (tax, shipping, etc.). Payment details and schedules are available on your Dashboard, under Settings and Affiliate Guide.

Only completed transactions qualify for commission. We uphold a fair use policy, reserving the right to review referral orders. Refunds or chargebacks negate commission earnings.

4. Marketing Support

Access promotional materials—banners, logos, and collection promotions—via the Marketing Tools section. These resources are available for download or embedding, facilitating your promotional efforts.

5. Growing Your Network

Activate your network by inviting others to join as affiliates beneath you. Network commissions are earned from orders made through your downlines, in accordance with our merchant settings.

6. Cookie Tracking

Our system uses cookies to track referrals from your link, requiring that the referred individual accepts cookies. Cookie duration is specified upon registration, with commissions earned on orders made within this period, without the need for repeated link clicks.

7. Opting Out

Should you decide to leave the Affiliate Program, please contact us at norian@norianlove.com.

We're thrilled to have you with us and wish you immense success. Feel free to revisit these terms as needed, and reach out to norian@norianlove.com for support or questions.

Embark on your referral journey with Norian Love, and let's create beautiful stories together.
